# Pau Hana Surf Supply
> Pau Hana Surf Supply is a California-based stand-up paddleboard (SUP) manufacturer founded in 2006. We design award-winning inflatable and hardboard paddleboards for every skill level — from beginner-friendly all-arounders to expedition touring boards and surf SUPs. Our boards are sold direct and through retail partners including REI and L.L.Bean. "Pau Hana" is Hawaiian for "finished work" — the moment you trade the daily grind for time on the water.

Website: https://pauhanasurfco.com

---

## Complete Paddleboard Lineup

### All-Around & Beginner Boards

**Stowaway Lite '25** — 11'0" × 32" × 6" | Inflatable | 18.7 lbs | 225L | Max Rider: 338 lbs | $999
https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/110-stowaway-lite-25
Our flagship travel SUP and lightest all-around inflatable. Award-winning 11' travel inflatable SUP — SUP Connect Gear of the Year 2025, Forbes Best Paddleboards for Dogs. Woven drop-stitch construction with double-layer rails delivers hardboard-like rigidity at just 18.7 lbs. Packs into a compact drybag backpack (22" × 14" × 12") for airline travel, road trips, and trailhead access. Stable 32" width suits beginners and experienced paddlers alike. Twin 9" quick snap-in fins (tool-free), full-length textured traction pad, planing hull. Available in Maldives Morning, Great Barrier Reef, and Glacier Bay colorways. Complete kit includes: board, 4-piece aluminum paddle, drybag backpack, compact nano pump, 10' coiled leash, twin 9" snap-in fins, waterproof repair kit, pre-installed bungee tie-down. Best for: lakes, calm coastal water, bays, light chop, yoga, paddling with dogs. Designed by Todd Caranto — first SUP designer to win Outside Magazine's Gear of the Year (2012).

**Big EZ Hawaiian** — 11'0" × 32" × 5" | Hardboard (EPS/Epoxy) | 30 lbs | 225L | Max Rider: 317 lbs (Adv Surfer: 350 lbs) | $1,299
https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/11-0-big-ez-hawaiian
The board that started it all — one of the first paddleboards designed specifically for beginners (2007). Classic all-around hardboard with a wide, stable platform that builds confidence on every paddle. Extra-soft EVA deck pad, single 9" fin with side bites, planing hull, ergonomic handle insert. Features the patented SeaMount® accessory system for attaching rod holders, cup holders, coolers, and more. Versatile for families, SUP yoga, fishing, and paddling with pets. Designed by Todd Caranto.

**Big EZ Hawaiian VFT** — 11'0" × 34" × 5" | Hardboard (Vacuum Formed Technology) | 34 lbs | 235L | Max Rider: 350 lbs | $1,299
https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/110-big-ez-vft
The Big EZ Hawaiian in VFT construction — a virtually indestructible thermoformed shell that resists dings, dents, and UV damage. Extra-wide 34" width for maximum stability. Extra-soft EVA deck pad, single 9" fin, standard 10" fin box, planing hull. Features SeaMount® system, ergonomic handle insert, self-regulating Goretex vent plug, integrated leash cup. Kevlar-reinforced rails for exceptional impact resistance. Ideal for rental fleets, families with kids, and rough-use environments.

**Big EZ Hawaiian Air** — 11'0" × 32" × 6" | Inflatable (Marine-Grade PVC) | 22 lbs | 255L | Max Rider: 338 lbs | $699
https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/110-big-ez-air-isup
An inflatable version of the Big EZ Hawaiian, combining the stability and all-around performance of the original with the portability and convenience of an iSUP. Marine-grade PVC drop-stitch construction. Extra-soft EVA deck pad, single 9" fin, planing hull. Features wheeled backpack for easy transport, soft neoprene handle, compact pump, 5mm bungee tie-downs, three-piece paddle. Packed weight approx 28 lbs — checks as regular airline luggage with room for 22 lbs of extra gear under the standard 50 lb limit. Suitable for surfing, yoga, flatwater, and light whitewater.

**Big EZ Livery** — 11'0" × 34" × 5" | Hardboard (VFT) | 34 lbs | 235L | Max Rider: 350 lbs
https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/110-big-ez-vft-livery-paddle-board
Commercial-grade rental paddleboard built with VFT construction for maximum durability in high-traffic fleet environments. Textured traction pad (more durable than EVA for fleet use), single 9" fin, standard 10" fin box, planing hull. 5mm bungee tie-down, ergonomic handle insert, self-regulating vent plug, integrated leash cup. Designed for SUP rental businesses, resorts, camps, and outfitters.

**Oahu** — 10'0" × 32" | Hardboard (EPS/Epoxy with Bamboo Reinforcement) | $1,299
https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/100-oahu
SUP Connect 2025 Gear of the Year. A 10-foot recreational board for paddlers with some experience who want a responsive, versatile ride. Classic nose rider shape with spooned-out nose and wide tail enhances wave maneuverability. Vacuum-compressed EPS core with epoxy resin, bamboo reinforcements in load-bearing areas, high-density Corebrace supports, self-regulating Goretex vent plug. Available in Woody (Cherry Burl veneer) and EPX (lightweight with sleek finishes). Versatile for flatwater, light surf, yoga, and coastal exploring. Not intended as a heavy-duty fleet board — this is a personal performance craft.

## Gear & Accessories

**SUP Paddles**
https://pauhanasurfco.com/collections/paddles
Adjustable and fixed-length paddles in carbon, fiberglass, and aluminum. Adjustable paddles are great for families and beginners who haven't dialed in their ideal length. Fixed-length paddles are lighter and more efficient for experienced paddlers.

**Accessories Collection**
https://pauhanasurfco.com/collections/accessories
SeaMount-compatible accessories including rod holders, cup holders, paddle clips, D-ring bungee systems, leashes, and deck bags. The SeaMount system allows gear to be attached and removed without tools across most Pau Hana hardboards and select inflatables.

## Guides & Educational Resources

**Board Selection Guide: How to Choose the Right Paddle Board**
https://pauhanasurfco.com/blogs/stories/how-to-choose-the-right-paddle-board
A comprehensive guide covering five key factors: intended use (recreational, touring, fishing, yoga/fitness), experience level (beginner, intermediate, advanced), board size and weight capacity, construction materials (EPS, VFT, Ricochet, TPU, ABS), and accessories/customization through the SeaMount system. Includes specific board recommendations for each category.

**Find Your Perfect Paddleboard**
https://pauhanasurfco.com/pages/find-your-perfect-paddleboard
An interactive recommendation tool that matches paddlers with the right board based on their experience, intended use, and preferences.

**Beginner's Guide: How to Stand Up Paddleboard**
https://pauhanasurfco.com/pages/how-to-stand-up-paddleboard-sup
A step-by-step guide for first-time paddlers covering board selection, paddle sizing (shaka method — extend arm overhead, paddle handle should reach your pinky), stance, stroke technique, turning, and safety essentials. Includes sections on choosing the right gear, PFDs, leashes, and what to wear.

**SUP Safety: 8 Essential Items Every Paddleboarder Needs**
https://pauhanasurfco.com/blogs/stories/sup-safety
Covers the must-have safety equipment: PFD/life jacket (legally required in most areas), leash (coiled for flatwater, quick-release for whitewater, straight for surf), whistle, sun protection, navigation lights for low-visibility conditions, helmet and quick-release harness for whitewater, GPS/navigation, and rescue beacons for remote paddling.

**FAQs**
https://pauhanasurfco.com/pages/faqs
Frequently asked questions about paddleboard selection, shipping, care and maintenance, warranty, and general paddling information.

**SUP Care & Maintenance**
https://pauhanasurfco.com/pages/sup-care-maintenance
Instructions for cleaning, storing, and maintaining both hardboard and inflatable paddleboards to extend their lifespan.

**Product Manuals**
https://pauhanasurfco.com/pages/pau-hana-user-manuals
Downloadable user manuals for all Pau Hana paddleboard models.

## Construction Technologies

**Woven Drop-Stitch (Inflatable):** Ultra-light construction using two layers of woven cloth attached at thousands of points with high-tensile fibers connecting top and bottom layers. Creates a stable, rigid structure when inflated. Used on Stowaway Lite and Solo SUP.

**Marine-Grade PVC Drop-Stitch (Inflatable):** Heavy-duty inflatable construction using marine-grade PVC for maximum durability and rigidity. Used on Big EZ Hawaiian Air and other all-conditions inflatables.

**EPS/Epoxy (Hardboard):** Vacuum-compressed EPS foam core infused with epoxy resin. Bamboo reinforcements in load-bearing areas, high-density Corebrace supports. Lightweight with premium finish. Used on Oahu, Moon Mist, and standard hardboard models.

**VFT (Vacuum Formed Technology):** A thermoformed shell that creates a virtually indestructible outer layer. Resists dings, dents, and UV damage. Kevlar-reinforced rails for exceptional impact resistance. Self-regulating Goretex vent plug. Ideal for rental fleets, families, and rocky conditions. Used on Big EZ Hawaiian VFT, Big EZ Livery, Endurance VFT, Navio VFT, and Malibu Classic.

**Ricochet® Construction:** An advanced impact-resistant membrane seamlessly integrated into fiberglass construction. Increases breaking strength by 3X while adding minimal weight. Designed for fishing, expedition touring, and environments with rocks, debris, and rough launches. Used on Endurance, Endurance XL, and Big EZ Angler.

**TPU (Thermoplastic Polyurethane):** An eco-friendly alternative to PVC used in select inflatable models. TPU is lighter, more durable, UV-resistant, and more environmentally responsible than traditional PVC bladders. Used on Moon Mist TPU.

**SeaMount® Accessory System:** A patented universal mounting system built into most Pau Hana hardboards and select inflatables. Threaded anchor points allow tool-free attachment of rod holders, cup holders, coolers, camera mounts, paddle clips, and other accessories. Up to 35 mount points on expedition models.

## Company Information

**About Pau Hana Surf Supply**
https://pauhanasurfco.com/pages/about-pau-hana
Founded in 2006 in California by Todd Caranto. "Pau Hana" means "finished work" in Hawaiian — that moment when you leave the desk and head for the water. Started as a premier materials supplier for surfboard shapers across Hawaii and the mainland before evolving into a paddleboard manufacturer. Our Santa Clarita design lab uses computational fluid dynamics (CFD) to model hydrodynamics digitally, then prototypes are tested in real-world conditions in Ventura surf and Santa Monica Bay. Boards are engineered using aerospace-grade composites and refined by hand with classic surf craftsmanship.

**Headquarters:** 25570 Rye Canyon Rd. Unit I, Santa Clarita, CA 91355
**Hours:** Mon–Fri 10am–5pm, Sat–Sun Closed
**Phone/Contact:** https://pauhanasurfco.com/pages/contact-us
**New Zealand:** https://pauhanasurfco.co.nz

**Warranty**
https://pauhanasurfco.com/pages/warranty

**Shipping**
https://pauhanasurfco.com/pages/shipping
Inflatable boards ship same day or next business day. Hard boards ship for a flat rate of $99 per board, delivered to a nearby freight terminal for pickup. Home delivery available in Southern California. All orders shipped from the United States.
